edge.text: The causeway runs out at the edge of the marsh. From here on it is reeds, black water and stepping stones.

reeds.text: Clouds of midges rise from the reeds. By the time you are through them your skin burns and your head swims: marsh fever. It will drain you a little with every step until someone treats it.

choices.text: Follow the smoke to a hut

hut.text: A hedge witch opens the door, takes one look at your muddy boots and spits a word at you. Your arms go heavy: a hex, -2 Skill while it lasts. "It'll wear off in three steps," she says, and shuts the door.

stones.text: The stones lead deeper in. Hex {hex}, Skill {skill}.

heron.text: A grey heron watches you pass. Hex {hex}, Skill {skill}.

healer.text: On a dry hummock an old man is boiling willow bark. He hands you a cup without a word. The fever breaks.

ditch.text: A deep ditch cuts across the last stretch. You will have to jump it: roll two dice, and you need your Skill ({skill}) or less.

mud.text: You land short and the mud takes you to the waist. It takes an hour to drag yourself out, and the light is going. You turn back.

out.text: You land on firm ground. Ahead, the marsh gives way to fields and a road.
